run_training_loop: run the Listen to Look single modality training loop with audio preview classification
build_model_with_modelbuilder: build the audio preview LSTM model using ModelBuilder with classifier and image audio classifier nets
create_training_dataset: create a training dataset and collate function for the Listen to Look model
validate_model: validate the trained model on the validation dataset and return mAP, accuracy, and loss
setup_checkpointer: setup a Checkpointer to save and load model checkpoints with optimizer and scheduler state
